title: Tea for Thy Master
summary: Protect the tea master while defeating the poison master and his recurring pet.
overview: Protect the tea master while defeating the poison master and his recurring pet.

roles.label: Everyone
tips: Intercept the pets promptly and protect the tea master while finishing the poison master.

sections.title: Encounter plan
bullets: The tea master's mission dialogue spawns the poison master, a pet and two assistants.
The poison master begins a pet timer 25 seconds after spawn; later pets arrive every 97 seconds.
Pets seek the tea master, whose death is tracked by the mission.

notes: Approval E321. Source review only; deployment, database spell lists and live balance have not been verified.
